_source: spec p.35 (template library: arc, beat count, typical length, signature moment), p.30 #13 (named presets), p.17-19 (edit grammar), REQUIREMENTS R192-R195

_fields.id: What the plan Sheet's Template column and script.json `template` hold; baseline_plan.py --template NAME takes it (T12).
_fields.kind: template (the spec p.35 library) or preset (spec #13: a named, fully resolved variant of a template).
_fields.base: Presets only: the template id it specializes.
_fields.arc: Ordered story beats [{beat, does}]. One spoken line per beat (lines may exceed beats for long reels); the outro beat is music-only.
_fields.typical_length_s: [min, max] seconds including the outro; default_length_s is the planner's --duration when the row gives none.
_fields.default_length_s: The planner's --duration when the row gives no length_s; inside typical_length_s.
_fields.length_class: growth (45-60 s), atmosphere (15-30 s) or null (the main-reel range, config render.length_s.main_reel); copy it to the plan row; shoot_card.py check rule 2 validates it.
_fields.signature_moment: {type, at, what}: type is plan.json signature.type (wipe needs a true before/after pair, else flash); at is the fraction of the voiced part (duration - outro) where it lands; what is the intent.
_fields.turn: {at, what} or null: the story turn as a fraction of the voiced part; baseline_plan.py --turn S = at x voiced seconds.
_fields.pacing: {beats_per_shot: [min, max], hook_s, outro_s}: shot lengths in beats (never over config render.max_shot_beats except the peak), hook text visible for hook_s, outro_s music-only seconds.
_fields.look: {default, before_turn}: plan shot.look values (warm, before, none); before_turn applies to shots before the turn (transformation only).
_fields.transitions: Allowed plan shot.tr values for this template, in order of preference.
_fields.hook_style: plan meta.hook_type and the metrics tag hook_type: question, contrast, tease, local, myth, number, first_timer, reveal, announcement, quote, behind_the_scenes.
_fields.goal: Default Sheet Goal (awareness, offer, community, education).
_fields.pillars: brand.json positioning.content_mix keys this template usually serves.
_fields.series: brand.json positioning.series ids it fits (empty: any).
_fields.needs: Material the template depends on; the scriptwriter puts it on the card and the Director checks it the night before.
_fields.kinetic_type: true: the reel uses large animated text cards (engine kinetic type, R195).
_fields.text_cards: [{beat, source: line|label, text?, max_words}]: a card shows the beat's spoken line (shortened to max_words) or a fixed label.
_fields.cta_style: How the CTA is matched to the goal.
_fields.example_hook: One hook in NUMA's voice that passes claims_scan.py.

templates.name: Transformation (before/after)
templates.what: A before/after of the space, a room setup or an event night: the old state, the work, the reveal.

arc.does: Tease the finished result in frame zero
The old state, plain and honest
The wipe: same angle, before becomes after
The finished space, warm light, someone using it

signature_moment.what: Before/after wipe on the turn line, same camera angle

needs: a true before/after pair from the same angle (else the signature falls back to a flash reveal)
templates.cta_style: Share line or soft invite; no outcome claims

templates.name: Class spotlight
templates.what: One class or session (Embodiment Flow Yoga, a guided breathwork class, the NUMA Experience): the energy, who it's for, how it feels.

arc.does: Who it's for, in plain words
Three moments of the class, one per line
How it feels at the end (experience language)
When it runs and how to join

signature_moment.what: Flash cut into the quiet moment at the end of class

needs: class footage filmed during the class (capture moment)
consented people for any face
templates.cta_style: Class time and the booking link from brand.json business.cta_link

templates.name: Member story
templates.what: One member or first-timer in their own words: why they came, the first time, what it's like now. Consent required.
templates.example_hook: I told everyone I would never get in that plunge.

arc.does: Their line, on screen and spoken
The first seconds in the cold or the heat
What it's like now (feelings, not outcomes)
Share line: send it to the friend who 'could never'

turn.what: The first seconds in the water

needs: a consented member (consent list only)
their voice memo or Katie reading their words
templates.cta_style: Share line; no booking pitch needed

templates.name: Modality explainer
templates.what: What a modality is and how a session goes (sauna, cold plunge, red light, breathwork), education only, within the claims policy.
templates.example_hook: Sauna vs infrared vs red light: what's different?

arc.does: The question, on screen and spoken
What it is, in one plain sentence
How a session at NUMA goes
What people say it feels like (experience, never outcome)
Who should check with their doctor first, when it's heat or cold

signature_moment.what: Flash into the water or the steam on the 'how' line

needs: Katie on camera or her voice (Ask the DPT)
the room the modality lives in
templates.cta_style: Save it or send it; never booking in an Ask the DPT reel

templates.name: Offer promo
templates.what: One offer (Discover NUMA, one month for $49 from brand.json offerings.offers): what it is, what a first visit feels like, how to start.

arc.does: The offer and price in frame zero
What a first visit feels like

signature_moment.what: Flash to the warmest shot on the 'first visit' line

the front of house or the plunge room

consented guests for any face
